name: Salsa moña horn line
desc: The moña: a legato octave-doubled horn line rather than stabs, weaving a singable melodic hook through an I-vi-IV-V vamp in Bb (Bb Gm Eb F) that turns over each cycle, drenched in dotted delay. Sawtooth section with a slow filter bloom; peak breaks into fast 16th unison runs that leap the octave.

code.sparse: note("<[d5 ~ f5 ~ bb4 d5 ~ f5] [d5 ~ bb4 ~ g4 bb4 ~ d5] [g4 ~ bb4 ~ eb4 g4 ~ bb4] [a4 ~ c5 ~ f4 a4 ~ c5]>").add(note(${root})).s("sawtooth").attack(.02).decay(.3).sustain(.5).release(.15).lpf(sine.range(${cut}*.6, ${cut}*1.1).slow(16)).lpq(2).shape(.15).gain(${gain}*.85).room(${room}).delay("${wet}:.375:.4").orbit(5).play()
code.peak: note("<[d5 f5 bb5 a5 f5 d5 bb4 d5 f5 bb5 a5 f5 d5 bb4 f4 d4] [d5 bb4 g4 bb4 d5 g5 d5 bb4 g4 bb4 d5 g5 d5 bb4 g4 d4] [g4 bb4 eb5 g5 eb5 bb4 g4 bb4 eb5 g5 bb5 g5 eb5 bb4 g4 eb4] [a4 c5 f5 a5 f5 c5 a4 c5 f5 a5 c6 a5 f5 c5 a4 f4]>").add(note(${root})).s("sawtooth").attack(.015).decay(.2).sustain(.45).release(.1).lpf(sine.range(${cut}*.9, ${cut}*1.7).slow(8)).lpq(3).shape(.25).gain(${gain}*.8).room(${room}).delay("${wet}:.375:.5").lastOf(4, x=>x.ply(2)).orbit(5).play()
